Report on the Arrival of Crown Prince Erjk Droes of Thýven

On 10 Feb , at 2:45 PM, the Douglas DC-8, which serves as the official state airplane for the royal family of Thýven, landed at the Luftstadt Aether Airport in Aurelia.

Upon the Crown Prince's arrival, the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Ekpatanus, Jürgen Andropolous, was present to greet him personally. Following the ceremonial welcome and a display of the armed forces, both the Crown Prince and Minister Andropolous commenced their journey to the residence of His Royal Highness.

Accompanied by an escort from the Royal Guard of Ekpatanus, known as Φύλακες του Ολύμπου (Wächter des Olymp), they proceeded to the family palace of Kaesarus III Sam Michaelidis, namely the Κάστρο Ηλυσίου (Elysium-Schloss).

This visit marks a significant step in fostering the relationship between the Kingdom of Ekpatanus and the Kingdom of Thýven ahead of the upcoming ETO summit
